messages:
deploy-bot: deploy completed to prod: rtx-service v2.13 (deploy_id=9fa4) at 12:03 UTC
infra-liz: seeing p95 jump in rollout dashboard, gateways returning 503s and timeouts around 12:02-12:04
sre-eli: paging oncall @oncall-marc — p99 went 4.2s -> 15s, 5xx rate from 0.1% -> 2.3% in the EU region
oncall-marc: ack, I'm on it. pulling traces and gateway logs now
ops-jen: CS reporting increased error reports from EU customers, some timed-out requests in the logs
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT OPENED: INC-12345 - Elevated 5xx/timeouts (rtx-service)
oncall-marc: initial look: many backend gRPC keepalive resets and kv fetch latencies spiking, looks correlated with new model weights load during deploy
sre-eli: kvcache eviction heatmap shows large eviction burst at 12:02, memory free spiked then reclaimed
infra-liz: note: this deploy enabled a new kernel numa balancing flag on infra nodes for model loading -- could be affecting memory locality
prod-aaron: can we scope to variant? If this is model-weight load, fallback to v2.12 until we investigate
oncall-marc: recommend immediate rollback to v2.12, rolling back now unless anyone objects
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: rolling rtx-service from v2.13 -> v2.12 (rollback_id=9f9b), estimated completion ~3m
customer-aly: starting incident update for status.redwood.ai: "Partial errors and degraded latency in EU for rtx-service. Mitigating: rolling back deployment. More updates soon."
oncall-marc: rollback in progress, watching p95/p99 and 5xx. will update when metrics show recovery
sre-eli: dumping heap/kv metrics now and saving flamegraphs/trace snapshots for postmortem
infra-liz: also lowering mux concurrency on gateway for rtx-service to limit inflight requests while rollback completes
ops-jen: good call. set circuit-breaker to conservative thresholds for the service in the EU region
oncall-marc: rollback finished. p95 trending back toward baseline, 5xx rate falling. keeping monitoring for 20m to confirm stability
sre-eli: collecting logs around the mass eviction window, will start a postmortem draft and include kernel flag + model weight load steps
prod-aaron: follow-up actions: (1) revert kernel flag in staging and run soak, (2) add KV warmup before rolling model weights, (3) add quick rollback playbook note
ops-jen: is there notable customer impact count? CS provided ~120 distinct error tickets from EU in the 12:02-12:10 window
customer-aly: confirmed those tickets, opened a follow-up update to customers who reported failures; no PII exposed, mostly timeouts/error pages
oncall-marc: handing incident to @sre-eli for post-rollback validation and postmortem. I'll be offline in 15m but reachable if alarms fire
pagerduty-bot: HANDOFF: @sre-eli is assigned as incident lead. Status: monitoring
sre-eli: ack, taking over. will correlate kvcache, kernel flag, and model load timeline, and coordinate RCA and mitigations.
